title: 「縮短副詞子句：when _ while _ if」
titleEn: Reducing adverb clauses with when, while and if

source.file: Sentence Structure 120 - 「縮短副詞子句：when _ while _ if」.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: when / while / if + subject + be + complement, + main clause

formulas.formula: when / while / if + subject + be + complement, + main clause
when / while / if + adjective / prepositional phrase / -ing phrase / past participle, + main clause
Main clause + when / while / if + reduced phrase

rules.zh: 刪去重複的主詞和 be 動詞 當副詞子句的主詞與主句的主詞相同時，通常可以刪去副詞子句中的「主詞＋be」。
rules.en: Remove the repeated subject and the verb be when the adverb clause and main clause share the same subject.
examples: While preparing dinner, Maya listened to the radio.

rules.zh: be 後面的部分必須保留 刪去主詞和 be 後，原本位於 be 後面的形容詞、介詞片語、現在分詞或過去分詞仍要保留。 形容詞 adjective 介詞片語 prepositional phrase 現在分詞 -ing phrase 過去分詞 past participle
rules.en: Keep the complement that followed be. After deleting the subject and be, retain the original adjective, prepositional phrase, -ing phrase or past participle.
examples: When connected to Wi-Fi, the device updates automatically.

rules.zh: when、while 和 if 的意思不同 ● when：表示某個時間、情況或每當某事發生。 ● while：表示某個動作正在進行期間。 ● if：表示某個條件成立時。
rules.en: When, while and if express different relationships: when marks a time, situation or repeated occasion; while marks the period during which an action is in progress; and if introduces a condition.
examples: when：表示某個時間、情況或每當某事發生。
while：表示某個動作正在進行期間。

rules.zh: 省略後的主詞必須清楚 縮短片語所描述的人或事物，通常必須是主句的主詞。 駕駛的人是 Maya。 這句錯誤地令人以為「the rain」正在駕駛。
rules.en: The understood subject of the reduced clause must remain clear and is normally the subject of the main clause. In the correct example Maya is driving; the incorrect version illogically makes the rain appear to be driving.
examples: While driving, Maya listened to the radio.

rules.zh: 部分固定說法可以省略 it is 以下是常見的固定縮短形式：
rules.en: Some fixed expressions allow it is to be omitted, including if necessary, if possible, when appropriate and if required.

rules.zh: 句首的縮短副詞子句後通常要加逗號 縮短副詞子句放在句尾時，通常不需要逗號。
rules.en: Use a comma after an initial reduced adverb clause; when the reduced clause comes last, a comma is not normally needed.

benefits.zh: 讓句子更短、更直接 這個句型可以刪去重複的主詞和 be 動詞，以較少的字表達相同意思。 第二句較精簡，但意思保持不變。
benefits.en: It makes sentences shorter and more direct by deleting a repeated subject and form of be while preserving the meaning.

benefits.zh: 避免重複相同的主詞 當兩個子句談論同一個人或事物時，不需要重複寫出主詞。 可以簡化為：
benefits.en: It avoids repeating the same subject when both clauses concern the same person or thing.

benefits.zh: 清楚交代時間或條件 句首的 when、while 或 if 能讓讀者立即知道事情在甚麼時間或條件下發生。
benefits.en: It states time or conditions clearly: an initial when, while or if phrase immediately tells readers when or under what condition the event occurs.

benefits.zh: 適合指示、告示及操作說明 這類簡短句子常見於產品說明、工作指引、安全告示及規則。
benefits.en: It is useful in instructions, notices and operating directions. Such concise sentences are common in product information, workplace guidance, safety notices and rules.

benefits.zh: 增加句式變化 使用縮短副詞子句可以避免每句都以普通的「主詞＋動詞」開始，令作文、報告和口語表達更有變 化。
benefits.en: It adds sentence variety by avoiding repeated ordinary subject-and-verb openings in essays, reports and spoken expression.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.
